title: PheCheck™ Validation Study
summary: The goal of this observational study is to evaluate the performance of the PheCheck™ test for the rapid detection of phenylalanine (Phe) from a fingerstick sample, in patients 1 year or older with phenylketonuria (PKU) or hyperphenylalaninemia. The main objective is comparing the concentration of phenylalanine (Phe) in capillary blood with the reference method (DBS).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1 year or older and able to have a fingerstick blood collected
* Being monitored for Phenylketonuria (classical PKU, mild PKU, variant PKU, or hyperphenylalaninemia)
* Signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous enrollment in the study and has completed 3 study visits
* Inability to read and understand instructions
